comparison.objective: Hang two parts on separate moving overhead-conveyor hooks before a deadline.
comparison.physical_skill: Track moving hooks and thread large eyes over them, then release without delaying the conveyor.
comparison.success_condition: Each part hangs freely on its own hook for the specified interval at the mark; interference or conveyor delay prevents full credit.
comparison.reason: This is moving-target eye-on-hook placement. The candidate's stationary coaxial mandrel alignment, bimanual hammer strike, fracture regulation, and post-fracture fragment recovery are meaningfully different.
